verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a code editor for email content (docs-17) and a CLI giving scripts/AI agents 'full access' to workspace objects (docs-26), which could in principle be used to manage templates programmatically, but there is no explicit documentation of HTML/MJML template files, variable substitution syntax, or a workflow for storing/syncing templates under git version control. Missing for 10: explicit MJML/HTML template file support, documented variable/liquid substitution syntax, and a git/version-control workflow or template export-import API.
